# CPI Inflation Beats Projections, Bitcoin Holds at $74,000 as ETH, XRP Stay Flat

**Bitcoin** [(CRYPTO: BTC)](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BTC-USD), **Ethereum** [(CRYPTO: ETH)](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ETH-USD) and **XRP** [(CRYPTO: XRP)](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/XRP-USD) traded sideways after October CPI came in hotter than expected, strengthening the case for another Fed rate hike.

### October CPI Comes In Hotter Than Expected

Headline CPI rose 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% forecast, while core CPI climbed 0.3% versus the 0.2% economists expected, [as reported](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2120147296587251740) by Bloomberg.

Here’s how October’s price increases broke down by category:

- Food: +0.5%
- Energy: +0.7%
- Gasoline: +1.0%
- Housing: +0.3%
- Real earnings (private sector): flat

Core inflation accelerated to 3.7% annualized over the past three months, its highest reading since January 2025, Walter Bloomberg flagged separately. Supercore inflation, which strips out housing and food, surged to 5.5% annualized, the fastest pace since April 2024 and up sharply from September’s 4.6%.

The six-month core CPI rate actually eased to 2.7% from 2.9%, though an unofficial estimate pegs annual core inflation at 2.74%, up from 2.56% previously.

### Bitcoin and XRP ETFs Keep Bleeding Outflows

Spot Bitcoin ETFs logged \$201 million in net outflows Monday, extending BlackRock’s [(NASDAQ:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/IBIT)[IBIT](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/IBIT)) to a seventh straight losing session with \$213.2 million pulled from that fund alone. 

That follows a broader weekly withdrawal of \$1.28 billion that flipped Bitcoin ETF flows negative for all of 2026, now sitting at \$914 million in net outflows for the year.

U.S. spot XRP ETFs lost \$10.42 million on Nov. 9, [according to SoSoValue](https://sosovalue.com/assets/etf/us-xrp-spot) data, ending four straight trading days with no flows at all and marking the largest single-day outflow since March 9’s \$18.11 million withdrawal.

### Where BTC, ETH and XRP Stand Technically

Bitcoin trades below \$75,000 and all four major EMAs, with RSI near 34 signaling weak momentum. 

Further support sits around \$73,500, then \$72,000, while resistance lies at \$75,000 to \$76,400.

Meanwhile, Ethereum trades around \$2,060, extending its decline below all four major EMAs, with RSI near 30 approaching oversold territory. 

Support sits at \$2,030 to \$2,000, then \$1,900, while recovery faces resistance at \$2,130 to \$2,200.

XRP is down to \$1.06, trading well below its major EMAs, with RSI near 24 signaling oversold conditions that haven’t yet confirmed a reversal. 

Support lies at \$1.05, then \$1, while resistance sits at \$1.10, then \$1.22.
